digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow and blob-fetching materialization
propositions: GitHub Actions pytest matrix jobs on stale Gerrit patchsets (1129/1130/1131/1136) hung at 99% progress for 1.7–4.3 hours until manual cancellation, while contemporaneous runs with commit 96a0d5c3f (blob prefetch fix) completed in 4–17 minutes.

Affected patchsets omit commit 96a0d5c3f and retain the proven per-blob lazy-fetch mechanism: --filter=blob:none + read-tree + checkout-index without upfront blob refill causes ~40 sequential git-fetch RPCs per file, totaling ~2.1 hours on CI shallow clones.

The reusable workflow .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml test job lacks a timeout-minutes constraint, defaulting to GitHub's 360-minute limit; this allowed manual-clear dependence when the blob-fetch hang occurred and prevented automatic failure recovery.

Test test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract in affected patchset 1129 PS3 introduced an infinite loop: FakeJiraClient.search_issues ignored startAt/maxResults pagination kwargs and returned the same non-empty issue list indefinitely, causing the pager to never reach an empty terminal page and timeout after 3 seconds.

Added jobs.test.timeout-minutes: 60 to _build-and-test.yml to bound pytest matrix execution; 60 minutes preserves >3× margin over documented 10–16 minute normal duration while preventing indefinite queue blocking.

Amended FakeJiraClient.search_issues to slice its issue list using startAt and maxResults kwargs, allowing the pager to reach an empty page and terminate normally; the fix reduced test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract runtime from timeout (>3s) to 0.33s.
